concepts.gloss_en: The 'spirit of folly' — the irrational impulse/madness associated with the evil inclination that enters a person

members.note: representative; consistent usage across lm1:1, 19, 54 denoting the spirit of folly itself

concepts.gloss_en: The nullification/annulment of the spirit of folly (a predicated state) — distinct from the spirit of folly itself

members.note: predicate/state about the spirit of folly (its being nullified via ruach hakodesh), not the concept 'spirit of folly' itself — rule 4

notes: Second form is a clause ('the spirit of folly is nullified') describing an action/state about the first; per rule 4 an action/state about X is not X, so kept separate.
